whoItsFor: Security researchers and developers who reverse engineer Android APKs and want an agent-guided workflow for debloating, ad removal, dex patching, and repacking. It is written as an Agent Skill for tools like Claude Code or Codex.
useCases: Debloat or remove ads from an Android APK through surgical dex patching and repacking
Analyze packed or hardened APKs by identifying the packer, unpacking, and recovering a patched, installable build
Run runtime and server-side analysis of an app's behavior and network protocols
installCommand: npx skills add newliver666/apk-reverse              # install every skill in the repo
